subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The employer is too________ (generous) to give a bonus to the employees.
solution:
The correct answer is: **stingy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Generous **means showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)

 
 
• **Example**: *Her generous donation to the charity helped fund crucial programs for underprivileged children.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Stingy **means being unwilling to give, share, or spend; it implies a reluctance to be generous or open-handed. (कंजूस)
 
 
• **Example**: *Despite his wealth, he was known for being stingy, rarely contributing to communal efforts or charitable causes.*
 
 
 
• **Complete sentence**: *The employer is too stingy __to give a bonus to the employees.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Caring**" refers to showing concern, affection, and consideration for the well-being of others. (देखभाल करने वाला)
 
• "**Kind**" means having a friendly, considerate, and benevolent nature. (दयालु)
 
• "**Cripple**" means to cause severe and disabling damage to; deprive of the ability to function normally. (अपंग)
